messages:
ash: Heads-up  noticed an oddity on the econ dashboard after the canary rollout: per-model cost for model-sigma jumped for a handful of tenants even though traffic went down. Trying to understand why.
morgan: Can you share the per-tenant sample?
ash: quick query:
```
SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) as toks, sum(billed_cost) as cost, avg(latency_ms) as lat
FROM invocation_agg
WHERE model='model-sigma' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-26T11:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-26T12:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY cost DESC
```
ash: tenant-Q shows toks=120k cost=$9.2k (avg latency 210ms) but before canary it was toks=220k cost=$4.8k. Token count halved but cost doubled.
ty: Could be double-billing from retries or a route that billed a more expensive SKU after fallback. Any retry spikes?
ops-bot: [METRIC] router.retries.count spike for route /v1/generate tenant-Q at 2026-03-26T11:07Z (delta +740) trace=rt-cc7b
morgan: Looked at traces for a few invocations: trace=trc-9a4f shows original request routed to sku=model-sigma-v1.quant, then after a 503 it retried to model-sigma-v1.fp16 and both invocations recorded tokens. Billing ledger seems to have ingested tokens from both attempts.
ash: So we're counting tokens from failed attempts plus successful fallback. That explains increased cost with lower successful token count.
ty: Which component deduplicates attempts? We expected the router to emit idempotency_key so ledger can ignore retries with same id. Maybe the id wasn't propagated in canary config.
morgan: Canary introduced a subtle header strip in router v3.3-canary that removed X-Idemp-Key for internal retries. PR #5077 added the strip.
ash: Oh no. So ledger couldn't dedupe and charged both attempts. UI econ aggregation reads successful_invocation table which only has final attempt, hence lower tokens, while ledger summed raw attempts.
ops-bot: [ALERT] router-v3.3-canary: header-strip event detected 2026-03-26T11:06:48Z commit=6fda8 PR=5077
ty: Short-term mitigation: re-enable idempotency header in canary routing config and backfill ledger to remove duplicate attempts based on invocation_correlation_id.
billing-bot: [INFO] ledger-scan job queued job_id=led-scan-617 start=2026-03-26T13:00:00Z
morgan: For UI clarity we should show an "attempts vs billed" small pill on per-model card: Attempts=230k | BilledTokens=430k for that window. Hover explains retries count and dedupe status.
ash: Also add a warning flag when invoice > preview by >10% with link to reconciliation job. PMs will want immediate visibility.
ty: Long-term: enforce that X-Idemp-Key is immutable across retries and add test that router preserves it across canary/proxy changes. Also change ledger ingestion to prefer deduping by correlation id when present.
morgan: I'll open PRs: (1) revert header strip in canary (PR #5082), (2) ledger dedupe fallback implementation. Assign owners: ty=router revert + test, morgan=ledger dedupe, ash=dashboard pill + banner.
ops-bot: [INFO] revert-pr-5082 deployment started at 2026-03-26T11:45:00Z deploy_id=dep-8012
ash: Backfill plan: led-scan job will identify duplicated attempts and emit adjustment records. Will coordinate with billing to apply credits for affected tenants.
billing-bot: [ALERT] led-scan-617 found duplicate attempt groups for tenant-Q window resulting in $5,400 overcharge estimate. Ticket created billing/adj-3201.
ash: Putting temporary banner on econ dash: "Some invoices may include retry attempts billed separately. We're reconciling; affected customers will be credited"
ty: Postmortem action items: immutable idemp header test, canary checklist update, ledger dedupe + alert on retry/billed mismatch, UI attempt pill.
morgan: Thanks team. I'll post a short summary to #product and cc support + finance. Closing loop once credits applied.
ash: Credits applied for tenant-Q per billing ticket adj-3201. Closing thread.
